content.short: Kismi is a gamified SocialFi platform on TON centered around photo tournaments and popularity rewards.
content.description: Kismi is an engaging SocialFi platform built on the TON blockchain that gamifies the social media experience through real-time photo tournaments and popularity contests. Users participate in voting games to gain popularity and collect 'kisses' (points) that can be redeemed within the broader Kismi ecosystem, including its lifestyle marketplace and charitable initiatives. Kismi focuses on creating a fun and rewarding social environment where active participation is directly incentivized, leveraging TON's efficiency to provide a seamless user experience.
content.meta: Join photo tournaments and earn rewards on Kismi. Gamified SocialFi on TON via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
